grf.hypothesis: An executable repository preflight can prevent a detected unusual-experiment workflow from being treated as manual-safe unless its GitHub trigger set is exactly workflow_dispatch.
grf.strongest_counter_reality: A workflow may include workflow_dispatch and an automatic trigger, so a naive has-workflow_dispatch predicate can still allow automatic budget consumption. Marker scanning also cannot prove that unmarked code is non-experimental.
grf.falsifier: Compare naive manual-presence admission against strict trigger-set equality on one synthetic mixed-trigger workflow.
